For each top tier section (`#`), Extraction must be run before Plotting

# All SIV
## Extraction

### Ca*Re

Prerequisites: `runAll.sh` (stepTwo - stepFour)

```{r raw_cellIDs}
raw_cellIDs <- list()
counts.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/counts/")
output_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/raw_cellIDs")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

samples <- c(
  "D0",
  "D195",
  "Invitro",
  "Pacute",
  "W0",
  "W2"
)

all_cellIDs <- data.frame(cellID = character(), sample = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (sample_name in samples) {
  rawDataFolder <- paste0(counts.dir, "outs_", sample_name, "/raw_feature_bc_matrix/")

  tryCatch({
    rawdata <- Read10X(rawDataFolder)
    umi_counts <- colSums(rawdata)
    cell_ids <- names(umi_counts[umi_counts > 100]) # keep only cells with transcriptomes
    raw_cellIDs[[sample_name]] <- cell_ids
    cat("Loaded", length(cell_ids), "raw cellIDs for sample", sample_name, "\n")
    
    # Add to the combined dataframe
    sample_df <- data.frame(
      cellID = cell_ids,
      sample = rep(sample_name, length(cell_ids)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    all_cellIDs <- rbind(all_cellIDs, sample_df)
    
    # Save individual sample's cell IDs to CSV
    sample_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_raw_cellIDs.csv"))
    write.csv(data.frame(cellID = cell_ids), sample_file, row.names = FALSE)
    cat("Saved", length(cell_ids), "cell IDs to", sample_file, "\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error processing", sample_name, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
  
  if (exists("rawdata")) {
    rm(rawdata)
    gc()
  }
}

# Save the combined cell IDs to a single CSV
combined_file <- file.path(output_dir, "all_raw_cellIDs.csv")
write.csv(all_cellIDs, combined_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved combined cell IDs to", combined_file, "\n")

# To load this data in the future:
# raw_cellIDs_df <- read.csv("path/to/output/directory/all_raw_cellIDs.csv")
# raw_cellIDs <- split(raw_cellIDs_df$cellID, raw_cellIDs_df$sample)
```


### TenX
Prerequisites: `runAll_TenX.sh` (stepTwo - stepFour)

UMAP coords and cell size

```{r}
counts.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/counts/")

samples <- c(
  "D0",
  "D195",
  "Invitro",
  "Pacute",
  "W0",
  "W2"
)

output.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (sample_name in samples) {
  input.dir <- paste0(counts.dir, "outs_", sample_name, "/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

  tryCatch({
    seurat_obj <- SeuratPipeline(input.dir, sample_name, 
                                 output_dir = paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/"), 
                                 plots = TRUE, rds = TRUE)
    
    # Cell-level coordinates and clusters, no gene expression columns
    umap_coords <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap")
    sample_df <- data.frame(cellID = colnames(seurat_obj), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    sample_df$UMAP1   <- umap_coords[, 1]
    sample_df$UMAP2   <- umap_coords[, 2]
    sample_df$cluster <- Idents(seurat_obj)

    # Add sample and target columns to the dataframe
    sample_df$size <- colSums(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
    sample_df$sample <- sample_name

    write.csv(sample_df, paste0(output.dir, sample_name, "UMAP_coords.csv"))
    
    cat("Processed sample:", sample_name, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error processing sample", sample_name, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
  })
}
```

### combined counts

Prerequisites: the `### CaRe` and `### TenX` chunks above.

CaRe and TenX viral UMI are combined and deconvolved

```{r}
# Loading
samples <-  c(
    "D0",
    "D195",
    "Invitro",
    "Pacute",
    "W0",
    "W2"
)

care.root <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/CaRe/")
care.group <- c(D0 = "uninfected", W0 = "uninfected", D195 = "ART",
                Invitro = "invitro", Pacute = "viremia", W2 = "viremia")
TenX.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/reads/")

combined_data <- list()

for (i in 1:length(samples)) {
  sample_name <- samples[i]

  cat("Processing", sample_name, "\n")

  # Read all data files
  CaRe.dir <- paste0(care.root, care.group[[sample_name]], "/bamsort/reads/")
  care_file <- paste0(CaRe.dir, sample_name, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")
  tenx_file <- paste0(TenX.dir, sample_name, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")
  umap_file <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/",
                      sample_name, "UMAP_coords.csv")
  care_umi_file <- paste0(CaRe.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", sample_name, "_valid_cellID_UMI.csv")
  tenx_umi_file <- paste0(TenX.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", sample_name, "_GEX_valid_cellID_UMI.csv")
  
  care_data <- if(file.exists(care_file)) read.csv(care_file) else NULL
  tenx_data <- if(file.exists(tenx_file)) read.csv(tenx_file) else NULL
  care_umi <- if(file.exists(care_umi_file)) read.csv(care_umi_file) else NULL
  tenx_umi <- if(file.exists(tenx_umi_file)) read.csv(tenx_umi_file) else NULL
  umap_data <- read_migrated(umap_file, row.names = "X")
  
  # Skip if no data
  if (is.null(care_data) | is.null(tenx_data) | is.null(umap_data)) {
    cat("Skipping", sample_name, ": no data\n")
    next
  }
  
  full_preprocess <- NULL
  
  # Join TenX and CaRe and filter by minimums-applied UMI
  if (!is.null(tenx_data) && !is.null(tenx_umi)) {
    full_preprocess <- tenx_data %>%
      mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
      semi_join(tenx_umi, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))
  }
  if (!is.null(care_data) && !is.null(care_umi)) {
    care_processed <- care_data %>%
      mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
      semi_join(care_umi, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))
    full_preprocess <- full_join(full_preprocess, care_processed, by = c("cellID", "UMI"))
  }
  
  if (is.null(full_preprocess)) {
    cat("Skipping", sample_name, ": no TenX or CaRe data\n")
    next
  }

  full_processed <- resolve_multimap_gs(full_preprocess)
  full_processed <- full_processed %>%
    count(cellID, category) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(total = log1p(rowSums(select(., -cellID), na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  
  # Get cellIDs from Mmul_10 only df
  all_cells <- as.character(umap_data$cellID)
  all_cells <- unique(all_cells)

  result <- data.frame(cellID = all_cells)
  
  # Add UMAP data
  if (!is.null(umap_data)) {
    umap_processed <- umap_data %>%
      select(-any_of("V2"), -sample)
    result <- left_join(result, umap_processed, by = "cellID")
  }
  
  result <- left_join(result, full_processed, by = "cellID")
  result[is.na(result)] <- 0
  
  # Cell type filtering
  result <- apply_cd4t_gate(result, sample_name,
                            setdiff(colnames(result),
                                    c("cellID", "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "cluster", "size"))) %>%
    select(-size)
  
  combined_data[[sample_name]] <- result
  cat("Processed", sample_name, "\n")
}

output_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/dataframes/")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (sample_name in names(combined_data)) {
  current_df <- combined_data[[sample_name]]
  
  both <- current_df %>% filter(total != 0)
  
  write.csv(both, paste0(output_dir, sample_name, "_both.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(current_df, paste0(output_dir, sample_name, "_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```


### Tiers

The contrasts:

  - `GEX_vs_neg`: TenX-positive against clean negatives
  - `Both_vs_neg`: `both` against clean negatives, the TenX calls that do not
    rest on the TenX arm's thresholds alone
  - `CaReOnly_vs_neg`: the Ca*Re-added cells against clean negatives
  - `Union_vs_neg`: every called cell against clean negatives
  - `GEX_naive`: TenX-positive against every other cell, as a TenX-only analysis
    runs it, with the Ca*Re-only cells left among the negatives
  - `CaReOnly_vs_GEX`: the Ca*Re-added cells against the TenX-positive cells

Prerequisites: the Figure 1 TenX and Ca*Re per-UMI tables through stepFour, the
`<sample>_CD4T_counts.csv` marker tables, the per-sample UMAP coord tables and
Seurat RDS, and the ###combined chunk above. 

```{r tier_tables}
tier_samples   <- c("Invitro", "W2", "Pacute", "D195")
tier_combined.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/dataframes/")
tier_TenX.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/reads/")
tier_care.root  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/CaRe/")
tier_care.group <- c(D195 = "ART", Invitro = "invitro", Pacute = "viremia", W2 = "viremia")
tier_coords.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/")
tier_rds.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/")
tier_table.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/tiers/")
tier_deg.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/DEG/tiers/")
dir.create(tier_table.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tier_deg.dir,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tier_levels <- c("both", "GEX_only", "CaRe_only", "neg")
tier_tenx_positive <- c("both", "GEX_only")

# DEG thresholds
tier_fc   <- 0.5
tier_pval <- 0.01
# Pathway thresholds
tier_gsea_padj <- 0.05

# Minimum cells for contrasts
tier_min_cells      <- 10
# Filter to genes detected in >=fraction of the sample's CD4 T cells
tier_min_detected   <- 0.05
tier_exclude_genes  <- c("CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B")
# Matched negatives
tier_negative_ratio <- 5
tier_size_bins      <- 10
# Draws of the Ca*Re-only group downsampled to the TenX-positive group size
tier_n_downsample   <- 20

tier_contrasts <- list(
  GEX_vs_neg      = list(positive = tier_tenx_positive, reference = "neg",
                         match = TRUE,  by_cluster = TRUE),
  Both_vs_neg     = list(positive = "both", reference = "neg",
                         match = TRUE,  by_cluster = TRUE),
  CaReOnly_vs_neg = list(positive = "CaRe_only", reference = "neg",
                         match = TRUE,  by_cluster = TRUE),
  Union_vs_neg    = list(positive = c(tier_tenx_positive, "CaRe_only"),
                         reference = "neg", match = TRUE, by_cluster = FALSE),
  GEX_naive       = list(positive = tier_tenx_positive,
                         reference = c("CaRe_only", "neg"),
                         match = FALSE, by_cluster = FALSE),
  CaReOnly_vs_GEX = list(positive = "CaRe_only", reference = tier_tenx_positive,
                         match = FALSE, by_cluster = FALSE)
)


tier_reference_contrasts <- c(GEX_vs_neg = "TenX-positive", Both_vs_neg = "both")

tier_viral_umis <- function(sample_name, chemistry, cd4_cells) {
  reads_dir <- if (chemistry == "TenX") tier_TenX.dir else
    paste0(tier_care.root, tier_care.group[[sample_name]], "/bamsort/reads/")
  valid_suffix <- if (chemistry == "TenX") "_GEX_valid_cellID_UMI.csv" else
    "_valid_cellID_UMI.csv"
  reads_file <- paste0(reads_dir, sample_name, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")
  valid_file <- paste0(reads_dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", sample_name, valid_suffix)
  if (!check_migrated(reads_file)) {
    stop("No ", chemistry, " per-UMI table for ", sample_name)
  }
  if (!file.exists(valid_file)) {
    return(tibble(cellID = character(), UMIs = integer(), spliced = logical()))
  }
  read.csv(reads_file) %>%
    mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
    semi_join(read.csv(valid_file) %>% mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)),
              by = c("cellID", "UMI")) %>%
    filter(cellID %in% cd4_cells) %>%
    group_by(cellID) %>%
    summarize(UMIs = n(), spliced = any(is_siv_splice_category(category)),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# Reference cells drawn to match the positive group's composition 
tier_matched_reference <- function(tiers, positive, reference, seed,
                                   match_columns = "size", match_bins = tier_size_bins) {
  column_bins <- lapply(match_columns, function(column) {
    breaks <- unique(quantile(tiers[[column]], probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = match_bins + 1)))
    cut(tiers[[column]], breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  })
  strata <- setNames(do.call(paste, c(list(tiers$cluster), column_bins)), tiers$cellID)
  wanted <- table(strata[positive])
  set.seed(seed)
  unlist(lapply(names(wanted), function(stratum) {
    pool <- reference[strata[reference] == stratum]
    pool[sample.int(length(pool),
                    min(length(pool), tier_negative_ratio * wanted[[stratum]]))]
  }), use.names = FALSE)
}

# `positive` overrides the contrast's positive tiers, for the downsampled draws
tier_run_contrast <- function(obj, tiers, contrast, genes, seed = 1, positive = NULL,
                              match_columns = "size", match_bins = tier_size_bins) {
  if (is.null(positive)) positive <- tiers$cellID[tiers$tier %in% contrast$positive]
  reference <- tiers$cellID[tiers$tier %in% contrast$reference]
  if (contrast$match) {
    reference <- tier_matched_reference(tiers, positive, reference, seed,
                                        match_columns, match_bins)
  }
  n <- c(positive = length(positive), reference = length(reference))
  if (any(n < tier_min_cells)) return(list(deg = NULL, n = n))

  deg <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = positive, ident.2 = reference,
                     features = genes, assay = "RNA", test.use = "wilcox",
                     logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0, verbose = FALSE)
  deg$gene <- rownames(deg)
  list(deg = deg, n = n)
}

# Seurat object restricted to the tiered cells
tier_load_sample <- function(sample_name) {
  rds <- paste0(tier_rds.dir, sample_name, ".rds")
  if (!check_migrated(rds)) return(NULL)
  obj <- readRDS(rds)
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
  tiers <- tier_tables[[sample_name]] %>% filter(cellID %in% colnames(obj))
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, tiers$cellID]
  detected <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts > 0)
  genes <- setdiff(names(detected)[detected >= tier_min_detected], tier_exclude_genes)
  list(obj = obj, tiers = tiers, genes = genes)
}

tier_tables <- lapply(setNames(tier_samples, tier_samples), function(sample_name) {
  # CD4 T cells: passing the marker gate
  keep_cells <- as.character(
    read_migrated(paste0(tier_combined.dir, sample_name, "_all.csv"))$cellID)
  cd4_gate <- cd4t_gate_table(sample_name)
  if (is.null(cd4_gate)) {
    stop("CD4 T marker table for ", sample_name,
         " is unavailable -- run stepFive_markers.R")
  }
  cd4_cells <- intersect(cd4_gate$cellID[cd4_gate$cd4t], keep_cells)
  tenx  <- tier_viral_umis(sample_name, "TenX",   cd4_cells) %>%
    rename(GEX_UMIs = UMIs, GEX_spliced = spliced)
  care <- tier_viral_umis(sample_name, "Ca*Re", cd4_cells) %>%
    rename(care_UMIs = UMIs, care_spliced = spliced)
  coords <- read_migrated(paste0(tier_coords.dir, sample_name, "UMAP_coords.csv"),
                          row.names = "X")

  tiers <- tibble(cellID = cd4_cells) %>%
    left_join(coords %>% transmute(cellID  = as.character(cellID),
                                   cluster = as.character(cluster),
                                   size),
              by = "cellID") %>%
    left_join(tenx,  by = "cellID") %>%
    left_join(care, by = "cellID") %>%
    mutate(tier = factor(case_when(
      !is.na(GEX_UMIs) & !is.na(care_UMIs) ~ "both",
      !is.na(GEX_UMIs)                     ~ "GEX_only",
      !is.na(care_UMIs)                    ~ "CaRe_only",
      TRUE                                 ~ "neg"), levels = tier_levels),
      across(c(GEX_UMIs, care_UMIs), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)),
      across(c(GEX_spliced, care_spliced), ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)))
  write.csv(tiers, paste0(tier_table.dir, sample_name, "_tiers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  tiers
})

cat("=== CD4 T cells per tier, and median host library size (nCount_RNA) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(purrr::map_dfr(tier_tables, function(tiers) {
  tiers %>% group_by(tier, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarize(n_cells = n(), median_nCount = median(size), .groups = "drop")
}, .id = "sample")))
```

### Pathway scores
Prerequisite: the `tier_tables` chunk above has written `<sample>_tiers.csv`. Loads each per-sample Seurat RDS.
```{r pathway_scores}
rds.dir    <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/")
output.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/tiers/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pathway_samples <- c("Invitro", "W2", "Pacute", "D195")
# HIV/SIV-relevant Hallmark sets
pathway_candidates <- c(
  "TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB", "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
  "INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE", "INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
  "IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING", "IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",
  "TGF_BETA_SIGNALING", "WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING", "NOTCH_SIGNALING",
  "PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING", "MTORC1_SIGNALING",
  "APOPTOSIS", "P53_PATHWAY", "UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE",
  "GLYCOLYSIS", "HYPOXIA", "OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",
  "FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM", "CHOLESTEROL_HOMEOSTASIS",
  "REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY", "COMPLEMENT", "ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
  "MYC_TARGETS_V1", "E2F_TARGETS", "G2M_CHECKPOINT", "DNA_REPAIR")
pathway_n_random    <- 30
pathway_random_size <- 100

pathway_msigdb <- msigdbr(species = "Macaca mulatta")
pathway_hallmark_genes <- pathway_msigdb %>% filter(gs_collection == "H")
pathway_hallmark <- split(pathway_hallmark_genes$gene_symbol,
                          sub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway_hallmark_genes$gs_name))
stopifnot(all(pathway_candidates %in% names(pathway_hallmark)))

pathway_screen <- list()
for (sample_name in pathway_samples) {
  cells <- read.csv(paste0(output.dir, sample_name, "_tiers.csv")) %>%
    mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
    filter(tier %in% c("both", "CaRe_only", "neg")) %>%
    select(cellID, tier, care_UMIs, size)
  seurat_file <- paste0(rds.dir, sample_name, ".rds")
  if (!check_migrated(seurat_file)) next
  obj <- readRDS(seurat_file)
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
  cells <- cells %>% filter(cellID %in% colnames(obj))
  obj <- subset(obj, cells = cells$cellID)

  # QC covariates the scores are residualized on at plotting time
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  ribosomal <- grep("^RP[SL][0-9]", rownames(counts))
  cells <- cells %>%
    mutate(nFeature = Matrix::colSums(counts[, cellID] > 0),
           pct_ribo = 100 * Matrix::colSums(counts[ribosomal, cellID]) /
                            Matrix::colSums(counts[, cellID]))

  set.seed(1)
  genes <- rownames(obj[["RNA"]])
  random_sets <- replicate(pathway_n_random, sample(genes, pathway_random_size),
                           simplify = FALSE)
  names(random_sets) <- sprintf("RANDOM_%02d", seq_len(pathway_n_random))
  gene_sets <- c(lapply(pathway_hallmark[pathway_candidates], intersect, genes), random_sets)
  gene_sets <- gene_sets[lengths(gene_sets) >= 10]
  obj <- AddModuleScore(obj, features = gene_sets, name = "pathway_score", seed = 1)
  scores <- obj@meta.data[, paste0("pathway_score", seq_along(gene_sets)), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(scores) <- names(gene_sets)
  scores <- bind_cols(cells[match(colnames(obj), cells$cellID), ], scores)

  negative <- scores$tier == "neg"
  rho <- sapply(names(gene_sets), function(set)
    suppressWarnings(cor(scores[[set]][negative], scores$size[negative], method = "spearman")))
  is_random <- grepl("^RANDOM_", names(gene_sets))
  envelope <- quantile(abs(rho[is_random]), 0.95)
  pathway_screen[[sample_name]] <- tibble(sample = sample_name, set = names(gene_sets),
                                          rho = rho, is_random = is_random,
                                          random_env95 = envelope,
                                          depth_dependent = abs(rho) > envelope)

  write.csv(scores %>% select(-all_of(names(random_sets))),
            paste0(output.dir, sample_name, "_pathway_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sample_name, "-", nrow(scores), "cells,", length(gene_sets), "gene sets scored\n")
  rm(obj, counts); gc()
}
pathway_screen <- bind_rows(pathway_screen)
write.csv(pathway_screen, paste0(output.dir, "pathway_depth_screen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pathway_screen_fails <- pathway_screen %>% filter(!is_random) %>%
  group_by(set) %>% summarise(n_depth_dependent = sum(depth_dependent), .groups = "drop")
cat("Kept (depth-dependent in <= 1 sample):\n ",
    paste(sort(pathway_screen_fails$set[pathway_screen_fails$n_depth_dependent <= 1]),
          collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Dropped:\n ",
    paste(sort(pathway_screen_fails$set[pathway_screen_fails$n_depth_dependent > 1]),
          collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

### Tier DEG

Prerequisites: the `tier_tables` chunk.
```{r tier_deg}
for (sample_name in names(tier_tables)) {
  loaded <- tier_load_sample(sample_name)
  if (is.null(loaded)) next

  tests <- list()
  for (contrast_name in names(tier_contrasts)) {
    contrast <- tier_contrasts[[contrast_name]]
    scopes <- list(all = loaded$tiers)
    if (contrast$by_cluster) {
      scopes <- c(scopes, split(loaded$tiers, paste0("cluster", loaded$tiers$cluster)))
    }
    for (scope in names(scopes)) {
      result <- tier_run_contrast(loaded$obj, scopes[[scope]], contrast, loaded$genes)
      tests[[length(tests) + 1]] <- tibble(
        sample = sample_name, contrast = contrast_name, scope = scope,
        n_positive = result$n[["positive"]], n_reference = result$n[["reference"]],
        tested = !is.null(result$deg))
      if (!is.null(result$deg)) {
        write.csv(result$deg, tier_deg_file(tier_deg.dir, sample_name, scope, contrast_name),
                  row.names = FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
  tests <- bind_rows(tests)
  write.csv(tests, paste0(tier_deg.dir, sample_name, "_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n===", sample_name, "-", length(loaded$genes), "genes tested ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(tests))

  rm(loaded); gc()
}
```

### Print: downsampled Ca*Re-only
`CaReOnly_vs_neg` with the Ca*Re-only group downsampled to the size of the
TenX-positive group, `tier_n_downsample` times, each draw with its own matched
negatives. A gene that stays significant at matched n is not called only because
Ca*Re adds more cells. Writes `<sample>_CaReOnly_vs_neg_downsampled.csv`, the
fraction of draws in which each gene passes `tier_fc` and `tier_pval`.
Prerequisites: the `tier_tables` chunk.
```{r tier_downsample}
for (sample_name in names(tier_tables)) {
  tiers <- tier_tables[[sample_name]]
  n_tenx_positive <- sum(tiers$tier %in% tier_tenx_positive)
  care_only <- tiers$cellID[tiers$tier == "CaRe_only"]
  if (n_tenx_positive < tier_min_cells || length(care_only) <= n_tenx_positive) {
    cat("Skipping", sample_name, "- TenX-positive", n_tenx_positive,
        "Ca*Re-only", length(care_only), "\n")
    next
  }
  loaded <- tier_load_sample(sample_name)
  if (is.null(loaded)) next
  care_only <- intersect(care_only, loaded$tiers$cellID)

  draws <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(tier_n_downsample), function(draw) {
    set.seed(draw)
    result <- tier_run_contrast(loaded$obj, loaded$tiers,
                                tier_contrasts$CaReOnly_vs_neg, loaded$genes,
                                seed = draw,
                                positive = sample(care_only, n_tenx_positive))
    if (is.null(result$deg)) return(NULL)
    result$deg %>%
      transmute(gene, draw, avg_log2FC,
                significant = p_val_adj < tier_pval & abs(avg_log2FC) > tier_fc)
  })
  # A gene FindMarkers dropped from a draw counts as not significant in it
  downsampled <- draws %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(fraction_significant = sum(significant) / tier_n_downsample,
              median_log2FC = median(avg_log2FC), .groups = "drop")
  write.csv(downsampled,
            paste0(tier_deg.dir, sample_name, "_CaReOnly_vs_neg_downsampled.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sample_name, "-", tier_n_downsample, "draws of", n_tenx_positive,
      "Ca*Re-only cells\n")

  rm(loaded); gc()
}
```

### cNMF

Prerequisites: `cNMF_workflow.sh` for the first-pass runs, and the per-sample
Seurat RDS under `Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/`.

Annotate each pattern by inspecting top-loading genes to flag contaminant cell types
and quality-dominated patterns. Exclude these cells and rerun cNMF.

```{r}
per_sample_cnmf <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/cNMF/")
per_sample_rds  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/RDS/")

# Per-sample cNMF run name + RDS path + selected K.
#
# The first-pass runs come from
# extractionScripts/submissionScripts/Figure3/cNMF_workflow.sh <sample>, then
# cNMF_postprocess.sh <run_name> <K>; cNMF_workflow.csv carries the .h5ad input
# and the K below for each sample. The .h5ad itself is written from the Seurat
# object by pipelineScripts/cnmf/extract_h5ad.R.
#
# This chunk drops the CD3D-negative contaminant patterns and writes
# <base>_counts_cleaned.tsv into cNMF/subpattern/, which cNMF_subpattern.sh then
# factorizes a second time.
cnmf_configs <- list(
  D195      = list(cnmf_dir = per_sample_cnmf, cnmf_prefix = "D195",
                   rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "D195.rds"),
                   cleaned_rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "D195_cleaned.rds"),
                   counts_dir  = file.path(per_sample_cnmf, "subpattern"),
                   counts_base = "D195",
                   k = 8),
  invitro   = list(cnmf_dir = per_sample_cnmf, cnmf_prefix = "invitro",
                   rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "Invitro.rds"),
                   cleaned_rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "Invitro_cleaned.rds"),
                   counts_dir  = file.path(per_sample_cnmf, "subpattern"),
                   counts_base = "Invitro",
                   k = 7),
  W2        = list(cnmf_dir = per_sample_cnmf, cnmf_prefix = "W2",
                   rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "W2.rds"),
                   cleaned_rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "W2_cleaned.rds"),
                   counts_dir  = file.path(per_sample_cnmf, "subpattern"),
                   counts_base = "W2",
                   k = 8),
  Pacute    = list(cnmf_dir = per_sample_cnmf, cnmf_prefix = "Pacute",
                   rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "Pacute.rds"),
                   cleaned_rds = file.path(per_sample_rds, "Pacute_cleaned.rds"),
                   counts_dir  = file.path(per_sample_cnmf, "subpattern"),
                   counts_base = "Pacute",
                   k = 8)
)

n_top_genes  <- 30

# Min CD3D UMI count to call a cell CD3D+
cd3d_pos_threshold <- 1
# Fold-enrichment threshold for flagging a pattern as CD3D- (contaminant)
cd3d_neg_fold      <- 2

# Canonical marker sets
marker_sets <- list(
  Tcell        = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B", "TRAC", "TRBC1", "TRBC2"),
  Bcell        = c("CD19", "MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "MZB1", "IGHM", "IGHD"),
  Myeloid      = c("CD14", "LYZ", "CST3", "FCGR3A", "S100A8", "S100A9", "MS4A7", "CSF1R"),
  NK           = c("NCAM1", "NKG7", "GNLY", "KLRD1", "KLRF1", "FCGR3A", "PRF1"),
  Erythroid    = c("HBB", "HBA1", "HBA2", "ALAS2"),
  Platelet     = c("PPBP", "PF4", "ITGA2B", "GP9"),
  Mito         = NULL,   # matched by ^MT-
  Ribosomal    = NULL,   # matched by ^RPS|^RPL
  Stress_HSP   = c("JUN", "FOS", "JUNB", "EGR1", "HSPA1A", "HSPA1B", "HSPB1", "DNAJB1", "HSP90AA1"),
  Cycling      = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "PCNA", "MCM2", "CCNB1", "CDK1")
)

classify_pattern <- function(top_genes, cd3d_fold = NA_real_) {
  n <- length(top_genes)
  mito_frac  <- mean(grepl("^MT-",  top_genes))
  ribo_frac  <- mean(grepl("^RPS|^RPL", top_genes))

  hits <- sapply(marker_sets, function(g) {
    if (is.null(g)) return(0L)
    sum(top_genes %in% g)
  })
  hits["Mito"]      <- round(mito_frac * n)
  hits["Ribosomal"] <- round(ribo_frac * n)

  # Flagging rules
  quality_dominant <- (mito_frac + ribo_frac) > 0.40
  cd3d_negative    <- !is.na(cd3d_fold) && cd3d_fold >= cd3d_neg_fold

  call <- if (quality_dominant) {
    "QUALITY (mito+ribo dominant)"
  } else if (cd3d_negative) {
    sprintf("CONTAMINANT: CD3D- localized (%.1fx enriched in CD3D- cells)", cd3d_fold)
  } else if (hits["Cycling"] >= 2) {
    "BIOLOGY: cycling"
  } else if (hits["Tcell"] >= 2) {
    "BIOLOGY: T cell"
  } else {
    "unclassified"
  }
  list(call = call, hits = hits,
       mito_frac = mito_frac, ribo_frac = ribo_frac)
}

pattern_annotations <- list()

for (sample_name in names(cnmf_configs)) {
  cfg        <- cnmf_configs[[sample_name]]
  run_name   <- cfg$cnmf_prefix
  selected_k <- cfg$k

  # cNMF gene spectra: genes x patterns (z-scored)
  spectra_file <- file.path(cfg$cnmf_dir,
                            paste0(run_name, "_spectra_K", selected_k, ".csv"))
  usage_file   <- file.path(cfg$cnmf_dir,
                            paste0(run_name, "_usage_K", selected_k, ".csv"))
  if (!check_migrated(spectra_file, usage_file, cfg$rds)) next
  spectra <- read.csv(spectra_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  usage   <- read.csv(usage_file,   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

  # Load Seurat object to classify cells as CD3D+/CD3D-
  seurat_obj <- readRDS(cfg$rds)
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
  seurat_obj <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA")
  cd3d_counts <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = "CD3D", layer = "counts")
  cd3d_counts$cellID <- rownames(cd3d_counts)

  common_cells <- intersect(rownames(usage), cd3d_counts$cellID)
  usage_sub    <- usage[common_cells, , drop = FALSE]
  cd3d_vec     <- cd3d_counts[common_cells, "CD3D"]
  is_cd3d_pos  <- cd3d_vec >= cd3d_pos_threshold
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s  K = %d  |  CD3D+: %d  CD3D-: %d ===\n",
              sample_name, selected_k, sum(is_cd3d_pos), sum(!is_cd3d_pos)))

  # Per-pattern mean weight in CD3D+ vs CD3D- cells
  mean_pos <- colMeans(usage_sub[is_cd3d_pos,  , drop = FALSE])
  mean_neg <- colMeans(usage_sub[!is_cd3d_pos, , drop = FALSE])
  eps      <- 1e-6
  cd3d_fold <- (mean_neg + eps) / (mean_pos + eps)  # >1 => pattern enriched in CD3D- cells

  anno_df <- data.frame(pattern = character(), call = character(),
                        top_genes = character(), mito = numeric(), ribo = numeric(),
                        mean_cd3d_pos = numeric(), mean_cd3d_neg = numeric(),
                        cd3d_neg_fold = numeric(),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  for (p in colnames(spectra)) {
    top_genes <- rownames(spectra)[order(-spectra[[p]])][1:n_top_genes]
    fold <- if (p %in% names(cd3d_fold)) cd3d_fold[[p]] else NA_real_
    res  <- classify_pattern(top_genes, cd3d_fold = fold)
    cat(sprintf("  %-12s  CD3D-/+ fold = %5.2f  %s\n",
                p, fold, res$call))
  }
}


# Patterns to drop per sample
contaminant_patterns <- list(
  invitro   = c(3, 4, 6),
  W2        = c(6, 7, 8),
  D195      = c(5, 6, 7, 8),
  Pacute    = c(7, 8)
)

for (sample_name in names(cnmf_configs)) {
  cfg        <- cnmf_configs[[sample_name]]
  drop_idx   <- contaminant_patterns[[sample_name]]
  selected_k <- cfg$k

  if (is.null(drop_idx) || length(drop_idx) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%s: no contaminant patterns set, skipping clean+export\n",
                sample_name))
    next
  }

  dir.create(cfg$counts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  usage_file <- file.path(cfg$cnmf_dir,
                          paste0(cfg$cnmf_prefix, "_usage_K", selected_k, ".csv"))
  if (!check_migrated(usage_file, cfg$rds)) next
  usage      <- read.csv(usage_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

  seurat_obj <- readRDS(cfg$rds)
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
  seurat_obj <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA")

  common_cells <- intersect(rownames(usage), colnames(seurat_obj))
  usage_sub    <- usage[common_cells, , drop = FALSE]

  max_pattern   <- apply(usage_sub, 1, which.max)
  cells_to_drop <- rownames(usage_sub)[max_pattern %in% drop_idx]
  cells_to_keep <- setdiff(colnames(seurat_obj), cells_to_drop)

  cat(sprintf("%s: dropping %d / %d cells (patterns %s)\n",
              sample_name, length(cells_to_drop), ncol(seurat_obj),
              paste(drop_idx, collapse = ",")))

  seurat_clean <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells_to_keep)

  counts_mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_clean, layer = "counts")
  counts_out <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(t(counts_mat)))
  counts_out <- cbind(cellID = rownames(counts_out), counts_out)
  out_file <- file.path(cfg$counts_dir, paste0(cfg$counts_base, "_counts_cleaned.tsv"))
  data.table::fwrite(counts_out, out_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
  cat("Saved cleaned counts:", out_file, "  (", nrow(counts_out), "cells x",
      ncol(counts_out) - 1, "genes )\n")

  saveRDS(seurat_clean, cfg$cleaned_rds)
}
```


## Plotting
### Panels A, B, G

Prerequisites: the `### combined counts` chunk above.

UMAPs and cell counts (A = in vitro, B = in vivo W2, G = D195 ART)

TenX-CaRe combined counts used.

```{r}
input.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/combined/dataframes/")
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure3/")

TenX.dir        <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/reads/")
samples <- c("D195", "Invitro", "W2")
umap_panel <- c(Invitro = "PanelA", D195 = "PanelG", W2 = "PanelB")


tenx_only_splice_plus <- function(sample_name, keep_cells) {
  tenx_file     <- paste0(TenX.dir, sample_name, "_UMI_read_counts_full.csv")
  tenx_umi_file <- paste0(TenX.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", sample_name, "_GEX_valid_cellID_UMI.csv")
  if (!check_migrated(tenx_file, tenx_umi_file)) return(NA_integer_)

  tenx_umi <- read.csv(tenx_umi_file) %>% mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID))
  cd4_gate <- cd4t_gate_table(sample_name)
  if (is.null(cd4_gate)) return(NA_integer_)
  cd4_cells <- cd4_gate$cellID[cd4_gate$cd4t]

  read.csv(tenx_file) %>%
    mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
    semi_join(tenx_umi, by = c("cellID", "UMI")) %>%
    filter(cellID %in% keep_cells, cellID %in% cd4_cells,
           is_siv_splice_category(category)) %>%
    pull(cellID) %>% unique() %>% length()
}

for (sample_name in samples) {
  current_df <- read.csv(paste0(input.dir, sample_name, "_all.csv"))

  if (!"total" %in% colnames(current_df)) current_df$total <- 0
  splice_cols <- siv_splice_cols(current_df)

  pfx <- paste0(umap_panel[[sample_name]], "_")

  # Main panels are densities of the positive cells over the gray embedding,
  # quoted per 1% of the panel area.
  current_df$splice_pos <- as.numeric(
    current_df$total > 0 &
      rowSums(current_df[, splice_cols, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0)
  current_df$splice_neg <- as.numeric(current_df$total > 0 &
                                        current_df$splice_pos == 0)

  siv_scale <- umapDensityScale(current_df, "total")
  plotDensityUMAP(current_df, colorby = total,
    "SIV+ cells", output.dir,
    paste0(pfx, sample_name, "_UMAPdensity_siv.pdf"),
    density_scale = siv_scale, color = "red", legend_ends_only = TRUE,
    legend_label = "SIV+ cells per 1% of UMAP area")

  # splice+ and splice- share color scale
  splice_scale <- umapDensityScale(current_df, c("splice_pos", "splice_neg"))
  plotDensityUMAP(current_df, colorby = splice_pos,
    "Splice+ cells", output.dir,
    paste0(pfx, sample_name, "_UMAPdensity_splicePos.pdf"),
    density_scale = splice_scale, color = "purple", legend_ends_only = TRUE,
    legend_label = "splice+ cells per 1% of UMAP area")
  plotDensityUMAP(current_df, colorby = splice_neg,
    "Splice- cells", output.dir,
    paste0(pfx, sample_name, "_UMAPdensity_spliceNeg.pdf"),
    density_scale = splice_scale, color = "orange", legend_ends_only = TRUE,
    legend_label = "splice- cells per 1% of UMAP area")

  # Per-cell identity UMAPs of the same data: Supp Fig 1 Panel M
  current_df$identity <- ifelse(current_df$total > 0, "infected", "uninfected")
  create_identity_umap(current_df,
    colors = c("uninfected" = "#E5E5E5", "infected" = "red"),
    title = "SIV+ cells",
    point_order = "foreground_last",
    saveas = paste0(supp.dir, "PanelM_", sample_name, "_UMAP_siv.pdf"))

  current_df$identity <- case_when(
    current_df$splice_pos > 0 ~ "splice+",
    current_df$splice_neg > 0 ~ "splice-",
    TRUE                      ~ "other"
  )
  create_identity_umap(current_df,
    colors = c("other" = "#E5E5E5", "splice-" = "orange", "splice+" = "purple"),
    title = "Splice status",
    point_order = "foreground_last",
    saveas = paste0(supp.dir, "PanelM_", sample_name, "_UMAP_splice.pdf"))

  cat("\n", sample_name,
      "\nCells total:\t", nrow(current_df),
      "\nSIV+:\t\t", sum(sum(current_df$identity == "splice+"),
                         sum(current_df$identity == "splice-")),
      "\nsplice+:\t", sum(current_df$identity == "splice+"),
      "\nsplice+ (GEX only):\t", tenx_only_splice_plus(sample_name, current_df$cellID),
      "\nsplice-:\t", sum(current_df$identity == "splice-"), "\n\n")

}
```

cNMF pattern UMAPs + full pattern annotation

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure3/")
```
